description: EDSNA is the regional authority that manages the solid waste of Attica, the region of Athens, at the Fyli integrated facility and a network of transfer stations. It publishes its statistics as public projects in its request tracker, one for each year from 2015 to 2025, each holding Excel workbooks as attachments. The 2024 set includes annual data of the municipalities, the transfer stations, the mechanical treatment plant, recycling centres and the green city programme, plus the landfill fee calculation. The municipal workbook has a sheet for each month and gives, for every Attica municipality, the kilograms of mixed waste taken to landfill by municipal or private vehicles, delivered to the Schisto and Elaionas transfer stations, and sent to the treatment plant as mixed, green, organic or recyclable waste, with certified residues. The workbooks are free and available to download; no licence is stated. Caveats: the tracker interface is in Greek, items differ between years, and the tables mix kilograms and derived figures. Simulation uses: building a municipality to facility waste flow network for Attica, testing a landfill or transfer station outage, and planning treatment capacity. Related records: the ISPRA municipal waste register (data-ispra-catasto-rifiuti-municipal-waste) is a comparable source, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives Greek national totals.
